name: Aoife Byrne
headline: Product Manager
summary: Product Manager with 4 years of experience delivering user-centric digital products in fast-paced SaaS environments. Skilled in translating user research into actionable roadmaps and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship impactful features. Strong communicator with a track record of managing product backlogs and driving stakeholder alignment.

responsibilities: Own the product roadmap for a B2B analytics platform used by mid-market clients
Conduct regular user interviews and usability testing to inform feature prioritisation
Collaborate with engineering and design teams to define requirements and acceptance criteria
Manage the product backlog and sprint planning using Jira
Present quarterly roadmap updates to senior stakeholders
Supported senior PMs in gathering and prioritising customer feedback
Ran user research sessions to validate new feature concepts
Wrote user stories and maintained the product backlog in Jira
Assisted in coordinating release schedules across engineering teams
